title: projects-orchestrator events --json (v1)
description: Guard/usage events per project, read from each child's observability log. Consumed by harbor L0-6. NOTE: the emitted item is built by hand in `_cmd_events`, NOT via asdict(ProjectEvents) -- `ProjectEvents.path` is deliberately absent from the payload. A schema generated from the dataclass would therefore be wrong; this one is derived from real emitted output.

warnings.description: Non-fatal read problems -- a missing log, malformed lines. `no observability log` is the common case and is not an error.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601, or empty when the log line omitted it. Reader tolerates `ts` and `timestamp` on input.

hook.description: `unknown` when the line omitted it -- never absent.

action.description: `unknown` when the line omitted it. Reader tolerates `action`, `decision` and `event` on input, because project-init's guards log the outcome under `event`.

session.description: Agent session id, empty when the line omitted it. Lets a run's events be grouped across projects.
